critique.evidence: The screen materially advances the intent-integrity story by exposing a measured 69.6% recall gap for multi-merchant fanout, separating observed misses from evidence-quality caveats, and pairing the limitation with step-up review and verified post-review evidence. However, Mastercard relevance is only implicit in “multi-merchant,” and the screen provides no concrete missed transaction, miss numerator/denominator, metric provenance, or demonstrated control outcome. HTTP 200 responses do not prove those claims.
critique.fix: Show one sanitized payment-network miss with its intended action, model decision, merchant/fanout context, traceable metric numerator and denominator, and the resulting step-up disposition. Explicitly connect that workflow to the relevant Mastercard brief objective and demonstrate the uncertain-case control end to end.
